description: This is a test source file for the LoanStatusChangeHistoryListener class in the Fineract project. It contains unit tests that verify the behavior of the listener that responds to loan status change events, ensuring that history records are correctly saved based on configuration.

classes.name: LoanStatusChangeHistoryListenerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of LoanStatusChangeHistoryListener, particularly its event registration and handling logic, ensuring correct saving of history based on configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the thread local context and sets up the environment before each test.

methods.name: testGetLoanStatusesParseOK
methods.description: Tests successful parsing of comma-separated loan status strings into sets of LoanStatus enums.

methods.name: testGetLoanStatusesParseNOK
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid loan status strings, expecting RuntimeExceptions.

methods.name: testEventListenerShouldNotBeRegisteredWhenNONE
methods.description: Verifies that no event listener is registered when the configuration status is 'NONE'.

methods.name: testEventListenerShouldBeRegisteredWhenAll
methods.description: Verifies that an event listener is registered when the configuration status is 'ALL'.

methods.name: testEventListenerShouldBeRegisteredWhenValidStatusesAreProvided
methods.description: Verifies registration of event listener with specific valid statuses.

methods.name: testHistoryIsSavedWhenLoansStateIsConfigured
methods.description: Simulates a loan status change event and verifies that a history record is saved when the loan's new status is among the configured statuses.

methods.name: testHistoryIsNotSavedWhenLoansStateIsNotConfigured
methods.description: Simulates a loan status change event with a status not configured for history saving, verifying that no record is persisted.
